outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 518,293 live births in Alberta, Canada, from July 1, 2009 to December 31, 2018
finding: The incidence of live births following assisted human reproduction (AHR) in Alberta increased from 30.8 per 1000 pregnancies in 2009 to 54.7 per 1000 pregnancies in 2018, and newborns in the AHR group were more likely to be smaller and show signs of poorer health.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in the AHR group compared to the non-AHR group (40.5% vs. 23.3%, p < 0.001).
